description: The shape a wireframe stencil theme name must have (decision WIREFRAME-STENCIL-THEME): at most MaxLength characters from [A-Za-z0-9._-]. The library treats any other name as the default tokens (no warning, nothing stored), and a host that takes a theme from request input (a query string, an export body) should reject it with the same rule before it reaches a log or a renderer.

members.name: IsValid
members.description: true when name is unset (null / blank) or a well-formed theme name. Surrounding white space is ignored. Well-formed does not mean known: an unknown name is still valid and draws the default tokens.
